questions.q: In a \(45^\circ-45^\circ-90^\circ\) triangle, the hypotenuse is \(10\sqrt{2}\). What is the length of each leg?
questions.answer: **Answer:** \(10\). In a 45-45-90 triangle, hypotenuse \(= s\sqrt{2} \implies s\sqrt{2} = 10\sqrt{2} \implies s = 10\).

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In the right triangle shown, what is the value of \(\cos B\)?
questions.answer: \(\cos B\) is the adjacent side divided by the hypotenuse. Using the side lengths in the figure, \(\cos B = \frac{4}{5}\).

questions.target: Area, Volume, Similar Triangles, Circles & Right-Triangle Trig
questions.q: In the right triangle shown, what is the value of \(\sin A\)?
questions.answer: \(\sin A\) is the opposite side divided by the hypotenuse. Using the side lengths in the figure, \(\sin A = \frac{4}{5}\).

questions.q: What is the surface area of a cube with edge length 4 cm?
